}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "Model:GRM21L2", "P/N:08-04GRM2112" and "Ver:V1.2" are silkscreened on the board.
It's a 2-bay 1U Rackmount NAS. This device has 2x USB 3.0, 1x USB 2.0 and 1x eSATA ports. {{See also|Synology RackStation RS816|List of NAS Devices}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Marvell]] 88F6820 @1.33GHz :Dual-core ''Armada 385'' (ARM v7) *Memory: 512MB (SDRAM) DDR3 *Storage: 8MB (SPI NOR) Flash, :2x SATA, 1x eSATA slots *Network: 2x Gigabit Ethernet ports *USB: 1x USB 2.0, 2x USB 3.0 ports *Power: ~100-240V, 2.5-1.25A via C13
